parameters.query:
SELECT agent_id, health_url
FROM public.registered_agents
WHERE status IN ('active','stale')
  AND health_url IN (
    'http://filter-library-api:8000/health',
    'http://wordagent:4324/health',
    'http://pytestproject:5000/api/health',
    'http://reportagent:6000/api/health'
  )
ORDER BY priority ASC, agent_id ASC;

parameters.jsCode: const sources=$('Select Healthcheck Agents').all(); return $input.all().map((item,index)=>{ const paired=Array.isArray(item.pairedItem)?item.pairedItem[0]?.item:item.pairedItem?.item; const sourceIndex=Number.isInteger(paired)?paired:index; const source=sources[sourceIndex]?.json ?? {}; const result=item.json ?? {}; const failed=Boolean(result.error || (result.statusCode && Number(result.statusCode)>=400)); return {json:{agent_id:source.agent_id,status:failed?'stale':'active',last_error:failed?String(result.error?.message ?? `health probe failed: ${result.statusCode ?? 'unknown'}`):null,now:new Date().toISOString()},pairedItem:{item:sourceIndex}}; });

parameters.query: UPDATE public.registered_agents SET status=$2, last_heartbeat=CASE WHEN $2='active' THEN $3::timestamptz ELSE last_heartbeat END, expires_at=CASE WHEN $2='active' THEN GREATEST(expires_at,$3::timestamptz + INTERVAL '30 days') ELSE expires_at END, updated_at=$3::timestamptz, failure_count=CASE WHEN $2='active' THEN 0 ELSE failure_count+1 END, last_error=$4 WHERE agent_id=$1 RETURNING agent_id, status, last_heartbeat, expires_at, failure_count, last_error;
